themes.name: Livelihoods after arrival
themes.gist: The varied paid and unpaid work immigrants performed once in the new country, from mines and packing plants to domestic labor and pre-arranged farm work.
code_names: Domestic labor as only work after arrival

themes.name: The toll of labor and travel
themes.gist: How physical work in mines, factories, and smokehouses and the journey itself wore down migrants' bodies and stripped them of possessions.

themes.name: Costs and conditions of departure
themes.gist: The bureaucratic steps, fare manipulations, and home-currency economies that shaped the financial cost of leaving.
code_names: Barter and farm surplus as economy

themes.name: Regional networks as settlement aid
themes.gist: How immigrants from the same village or home region clustered in American towns and relied on one another to adjust.
